title: From Component Snapshots to Lifecycle Traces: Agent-Based Software Composition Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.18391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software supply-chain security requires accurate identification of third-party components and an understanding of how they evolve from development to execution. Existing software composition analysis (SCA) approaches examine manifests, build environments, release artifacts, containers, or runtime states, but typically produce only stage-specific views of software composition. As dependencies are resolved, removed, repackaged, and transformed across lifecycle stages, a single snapshot cannot capture both where a component originates and where it ultimately ends up. Combining snapshots from multiple stages still leaves their cross-stage relationships unresolved. We present SCA-Agent, an agent-based approach to lifecycle-aware SCA that reconstructs evidence-backed component lifecycle traces across Code, Build, Release, Deploy, and Runtime. translated_title: 从组件快照到生命周期轨迹：基于智能体的软件组成分析
translated_abstract: 软件供应链安全需要准确识别第三方组件，并理解这些组件从开发到执行的演变过程。现有的软件组成分析（SCA）方法通常检查清单文件、构建环境、发布制品、容器或运行时状态，但往往只能生成软件组成的阶段性视图。由于依赖项在生命周期各阶段中会被解析、移除、重新打包和转换，单一快照无法同时捕捉组件的来源及其最终去向，而组合多个阶段的快照也依然无法解决跨阶段关系的问题。本文提出了SCA-Agent，一种基于智能体的生命周期感知SCA方法，能够在代码、构建、发布、部署和运行时等阶段重建有证据支持的组件生命周期轨迹。SCA-Agent能够自适应地探索针对特定项目的分析路径，收集各阶段的证据，并……
tldr: 提出SCA-Agent，一种基于智能体的软件组成分析方法，可跨代码、构建、发布、部署和运行时全生命周期重建有证据支持的组件生命周期轨迹，克服了传统SCA方法只能提供阶段性快照视图的局限。
en_tdlr: SCA-Agent is an agent-based software composition analysis approach that reconstructs evidence-backed component lifecycle traces across the entire software lifecycle (Code, Build, Release, Deploy, and Runtime), overcoming the stage-specific snapshot limitations of traditional SCA methods.
